_comment: Escaped production defects from one release cycle, as a QE team would export
them from Jira. Synthetic, and shaped to exercise every attribution branch:
gaps GoldenFlow flagged and nobody closed, defects that slipped past a green
test, journeys mining never saw, and backend issues that were never

defects.title: Retry after declined card loops back to an empty cart
defects.notes: GoldenFlow flagged payment_method -> payment_failure as an uncovered gap in the M10 report. No test was written.

defects.title: Delete Account confirm button disabled for users with an open order
defects.notes: GDPR erasure blocked. Flagged as an uncovered gap; 2 sessions/week so it was deprioritised.

defects.title: Refund request submits but never reaches the backend
Wallet payment charges twice when Continue is double-tapped
defects.notes: A test walks this path and passed. It asserts nothing about the outcome - flagged as an assertion_gap in the M10 report.

defects.title: Order total shows pre-discount price on the review screen
defects.notes: Covered path, green test. The test asserts order_total is not None, not that it is correct.

defects.title: Promo code row overlaps subtotal on small screens
defects.notes: Journey not in the Golden set - the promo row shipped in 9.0.0 and mining had not seen it yet.

defects.title: Search returns stale results after backend cache eviction
defects.notes: Backend. No client journey to attribute it to.

defects.title: Push notification deep link opens the wrong product
OTP resend button has no rate limit
Saved cards list shows expired cards as selectable
defects.notes: Covered, green. Test asserts card_count() >= 0, which cannot fail.

defects.title: Contact Support form loses input on rotation
Data export email never sends for accounts older than 3 years
defects.notes: GDPR portability. Flagged as an uncovered gap; 5 sessions/week.
